commits.message: feat(core): add remote workspace environment seam

fix(desktop): authenticate SSH servers over one connection

Run every bootstrap step and the HTTP forward through one long-lived ssh
process, so password, OTP, and passphrase prompts appear once per connect
attempt on every platform, including Windows OpenSSH, which cannot
multiplex connections.
fix(sdk): resolve packed artifacts under strict Node ESM

limitations: Inventory of heads does not establish feature completeness.
Scoped comparisons inspect branch-only changes; they do not import commits.
Remaining branch features require source review, compatibility review and acceptance checks.
